title: Hardware Validating
author: Fresh_Heron_3707
selftext: I am grinding out an Android game on my pixel. My agents are great, I have built out a custom C++ and am using OpenGL es for the gpu. However the features even host simulated with an emulated pixel using android studio still need hardware tests on the pixel. I was wondering how do I validate quicker for my agents. I am creating more features and game play than I can validate.

replies.author: Fresh_Heron_3707
replies.body: I thought the best way to extract low level performance my google pixel was a custom c++ engine. I want to extract ever bit of performance from the Google pixel that I have. I am not trying to have this game run on a lot of hardware. I want console like optimization for 1 phone.

replies.author: Any-Blacksmith-2054
replies.body: Ah on, good point, then it will be painful. I'm personally happy with my Xiaomi Redmi and Godot

comments.author: gardens_and_dungeons
comments.body: Connect the phone to your computer via USB debugging tell it to patch the APK usually done in a minute or two.
